name: Cambodia eVisa
summary: Official Cambodia eVisa for tourist (T) and ordinary (E) visas, applied for online. Approval usually comes within 3 business days. You show the approval at an accepting port. Accepting ports: Techo International (KTI), Siem Reap Angkor (SAI), Sihanoukville (KOS), Bavet and Tropaeng Kreal land borders. Cham Yeam and Poipet are closed for eVisa entry until further notice.

other: Fee, stay length and eligible nationalities were not on the pages we could read. Check the portal before you apply.
The e-Arrival form is also required for all travelers, including eVisa holders.

steps: Fill in the application at evisa.gov.kh and pay the fee.
Get the approval by email, or download it from Check & Change.
Submit the e-Arrival form online within 7 days before you arrive.
Show the eVisa certificate to immigration on arrival.
processing: Within 3 business days, per the portal.

name: Cambodia e-Arrival card
summary: Every traveler, including eVisa holders, must submit the e-Arrival card. You can do it within 7 days before arrival or on arrival, and it is free. It is an entry form, not a visa.

other: Visa-free and visa on arrival rules were not confirmed on the pages we could read.
